intro: The SmartSpin sifts clumps into a sealed drawer instead of raking them into a disposable tray, so none of the old ScoopFree tray problems apply. It accepts most litters but has a clear preference.

facts.text: The PetSafe Pet Companion app needs a 2.4 GHz network.
Rated for cats up to 25 lb.
Works with any litter, though PetSafe recommends clumping clay for best results.
PetSafe offers US-based support by phone, email and chat.

symptoms.title: The drum will not spin
symptoms.summary: The unit does not start its sifting rotation, or stops partway.
causes: The waste drawer not fully seated.

fixes.detail: Reduce litter to the marked line and try again.
Push the waste drawer fully home.

symptoms.escalate: If it will not spin empty, use PetSafe's US-based support rather than resetting repeatedly.

symptoms.title: Waste is left in the litter
symptoms.summary: Sifting leaves clumps or smears behind.
causes: The litter clumps poorly. PetSafe recommends clumping clay.

fixes.detail: Switch to a clumping clay litter for best results.

symptoms.escalate: If sifting stays poor on clumping clay, contact PetSafe.
